freshness_policy_options.behavior: Remote probe failure logs [WARN] and continues pipeline using local DB without blocking deploy
freshness_policy_options.cons: Stale-success risk: may deploy outdated site without operator awareness

freshness_policy_options.behavior: Remote probe failure immediately halts pipeline with exit code 1
freshness_policy_options.cons: Completely breaks offline bundling, local testing, and air-gapped workflows
freshness_policy_options.risk: LOW freshness risk, HIGH usability friction

freshness_policy_options.strategy: Strategy C: Hybrid / Explicit Degraded Mode (RECOMMENDED)
freshness_policy_options.behavior: Local update/dry-run allows degraded mode with explicit warning; Auto-deploy enforces confirmed freshness unless explicitly overridden via explicit override mechanism
freshness_policy_options.pros: Perfect balance: offline bundle works seamlessly, while production deployment is strictly protected
freshness_policy_options.cons: Requires clean separation between local build and deploy validation

generic_primitive_contract.function_signature: fetch_story_json_by_id(story_id: int, manifest_hash_map: Optional[Dict[int, str]] = None, timeout: int = 15) -> StoryFetchResult
behavior_guarantees: 1. NO sys.exit() calls — returns structured error result or raises typed exception
2. NO report file side effects — purely in-memory execution
3. NO media downloading (M4A voice, background WebP, CG WebP) — handles JSON dialogues only
4. NO thumbnail or metadata mutation — pure acquisition primitive
5. Reuses provided manifest_hash_map when batching to eliminate redundant manifest downloads

batch_failure_policy.manifest_load_failure: ABORT_WHOLE_BATCH (Cannot resolve bundle hashes without manifest)
batch_failure_policy.story_hash_missing: COLLECT_FAILURE (Record as HASH_NOT_FOUND, continue remaining batch)
batch_failure_policy.bundle_network_or_parse_failure: COLLECT_FAILURE (Record as ERROR, continue remaining batch)
batch_failure_policy.write_failure: COLLECT_FAILURE (Record as WRITE_ERROR, continue remaining batch)
batch_failure_policy.batch_conclusion_gate: If any REQUIRED story failed -> Overall Exit Code 1; If only OPTIONAL failed -> Log warning & Exit Code 0
